summary.intent: Run the full ship-phase workflow for phase 60 (IPNS Verification Cross-Layer Closeout) — verify, secure, validate, simplify, SDK E2E gate, CodeRabbit CLI review, PR creation, and CI resolution — without babysitting.
summary.outcome: Pre-ship gates completed: verification report written (16/17 must-haves; staging smoke-test outstanding), two real bugs found and fixed (TS Validity fail-closed parity gap; ship-blocking API resolve regression from 60-05), SDK E2E gate green 89/89, security audit SECURED 27/27. Session ended before PR was opened; CodeRabbit CLI review and push were still in progress.

repo: Ed25519 IPNS records do NOT embed pubKey in the record protobuf bytes; pubKey lives in the IPNS name (k51…). The deleted `withCachedPublicKey` enrich in ipns.service.ts was load-bearing — it supplied pubKey from the separate `folderIpns.publicKey` DB column that publish validates as `deriveIpnsName(publicKey) === ipnsName`.

Unit tests for ipns.service.spec.ts mock `parseIpnsRecord` to include `pubKey`, which masks the real Ed25519 behavior where pubKey is absent from record bytes. The SDK E2E gate is the only suite that exercises the real round-trip.

The mock-ipns-routing server stores and returns the exact published bytes as-is; `parseIpnsRecordBytes` does NOT yield pubKey for Ed25519 records, so any code path that returns the bare network result is missing sig fields the strict client requires.
sdk-e2e test harness generates unique accounts per run via `email = ...-${Date.now()}@example.com`, so SDK E2E failures are never stale-data collisions — always real regressions.
60-05's CAPACITY.md §1.5 was already occupied by a prior-phase entry; the executor correctly created §1.6 for the D-11 verify-cache measurement.
The gsd commit helper reports `commit_failed` (lint-staged output) even when the signed commit actually lands — always verify with `git log --oneline -1` before any retry.

1Password SSH signing agent wedges after many rapid commits (`op-ssh-sign: failed to fill whole buffer`). Recovery: quit & reopen 1Password desktop app or toggle Settings → Developer → SSH agent off/on.

code.finding: TS resolve path silently skipped EOL enforcement when Validity was absent (not a Uint8Array), accepting records with no Validity field. Rust fail-closes at ipns.rs:114-117. Fixed to throw on absent Validity, mirroring the Rust contract (D-07 cross-layer parity).

60-05 removed `withCachedPublicKey(result, cached.publicKey)` and the equal-seq enrich on the false assumption that pubKey is embedded in the signed record. For Ed25519, it is not. On equal-seq the bare network `result` (missing all sig fields) was returned, causing the strict client to throw fail-closed on every publish→resolve round-trip. Fix: serve authoritative DB signed record on equal-or-higher seq.
parseCachedRecord now supplies pubKey from the validated publicKey DB column so the resolved record carries all fields needed for strict client verification.

The D-06 'enrich removal' test added by 60-05 mocked parseIpnsRecord WITH pubKey, masking the real Ed25519 gap, and asserted that signatureV2/data would be undefined on equal-seq — codifying the bug. Had to rewrite the test to assert the corrected behavior and add a new regression test that mocks without pubKey.
Rust fail-closes on absent Validity via .ok_or_else() — the correct behavior that the TS path was not mirroring before the fix.

workflow: The SDK E2E gate is the only suite that exercises the real client→API IPNS publish/resolve round-trip. It caught a ship-blocking regression that 351 Rust tests + 252 sdk-core tests + 172 API jest tests all missed because they mock the resolve boundary.

Sequential subagents on the main working tree (rather than worktree isolation) are safer for security-critical phases with interleaved Cargo.toml/lock changes — avoids branch merge conflicts and makes the build gate authoritative.
When running adversarial security sweeps in parallel with gate skills, they should be fanned out as background workflows to avoid CPU contention with builds and test suites.
A worktree agent that edits Cargo.toml without committing the Cargo.lock is a latent `--locked` CI break — always check for uncommitted Cargo.lock after dependency-touching plans.
Running `cargo test --workspace` as the authoritative pre-ship Rust gate is more reliable than per-crate checks since it catches cross-crate integration issues.

friction: 1Password SSH signing agent wedged after ~28 rapid commits, blocking all commits for an unknown duration and requiring a human to restart the desktop app.
gsd commit helper false-negative `commit_failed` fires on successful commits, requiring a `git log` verify step after every commit to avoid double-retries.
SDK E2E gate failed on first run (28/89 red) due to a real regression from 60-05, requiring full root-cause investigation and a multi-file fix before the gate could pass.
`gh pr edit` is blocked on this repo (Projects-classic GraphQL error) — PR body patches must go through `gh api -X PATCH` to a temp file.
`git push` and `git fetch` are blocked in the sandbox, requiring the sandbox to be disabled for all remote operations.
The adversarial audit workflow had to be re-invoked after the first attempt was launched with `run_in_background` as a parameter that doesn't apply to the Workflow tool.
